svg.aria-label: A background thread lists units, claims the next one with put_if_absent and loads its batches in step order, then goes back for another unit. It fills a buffer of eight batches; six are ready, steps 61 to 66. session.run takes the oldest batch and passes it to train_step, which sets the learning rate for its step, trains and returns the samples it trained. When the buffer is full the thread waits; when no unclaimed unit is left it ends, and run drains the buffer and leaves the loop.
svg.text: list units/, skip the claimed ones
load(unit): its batches, in step order
after the unit's last batch, back to 1
no unclaimed unit left: the thread ends
drains the buffer, then leaves the loop
While the GPU trains on one batch, the thread reads ahead, up to eight batches.
A loader or mailbox error reaches the loop after the batches already buffered.
